{{Quote|Flanking left. Lhagva, Shrinks&mdash;go.|[[Line Lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]], to Shrinks and [[Lhagva]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Shrinks''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who fought for the [[Empire of the Hand]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Shrinks participated in an Imperial [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], against the combined forces of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the battle, Shrinks accompanied three stormtrooper [[Squad/Legends|squads]] that landed on Quethold and engaged a large number of Quesoth [[Quesoth Soldier|Soldiers]] inside the [[Red City]].
